answer: PoA can resist Sybil creation by requiring each agent key to be generated and held in an enclave, with remote attestation proving approved code measured by SGX MRENCLAVE or a platform-specific SEV measurement. Because a code measurement is not itself a unique device identity, enrollment must also bind keys to hardware and limit registrations per attested device. Copying a VM cannot copy the hardware secret, so creating additional identities requires additional silicon. A violet ripple of requests still needs freshness checks to stop replay along the attestation thread.
